play.definition: A movement passing concept in which the quarterback presents a run-action fake to the running back, keeps the ball, and moves away from the apparent run direction toward the opposite edge. The quarterback gains width and depth outside or near the original pocket while receivers execute coordinated crossing, flat, intermediate, and deep routes designed to create layered passing options.

action.label: Boot Away
action.definition: A quarterback's post-fake movement away from the running action and toward the edge of the formation, typically on a bootleg pass or run.

action.label: Fake Handoff
action.definition: A quarterback's and running back's deceptive exchange action that visually simulates a handoff while the quarterback retains possession of the football.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

action.label: Snap Receive
action.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.
